meta.name: image-edit
meta.description: Edit images on RunComfy — this skill is a smart router that matches the user's intent to the right edit model in the RunComfy catalog. Picks Nano Banana Edit (batch up to 20, identity-preserving default), OpenAI GPT Image 2 Edit (multilingual in-image text rewrite, multi-ref composition, layout precision), Flux Kontext Pro (single-ref high-fidelity local edit), or Z-Image Turbo Inpaint (mask-driven precise region edit). Bundles each model's documented prompting patterns so the skill gets sharper edits without burning iterations on the wrong model. Calls `runcomfy run <vendor>/<model>/edit` through the local RunComfy CLI. Triggers on "image edit", "edit image", "image-to-image", "i2i", "swap background", "remove object", "rewrite headline", or any explicit ask to edit a single or batch of images.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用智能路由自动匹配最佳图片编辑模型
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要用AI快速编辑图片但不想纠结选哪个模型。
copy.tagline_en: Automatically route image edits to the best AI model.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need AI-powered image editing without choosing the right model.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会根据你的意图自动选择最合适的图片编辑模型，帮你批量修图、替换文字、局部修改或去除物体，并直接调用 RunComfy 工具完成编辑。
howto.when: 当你明确要求编辑图片，比如说“编辑图片”、“替换背景”、“去除物体”、“重写标题”等，或者提到“image-to-image”、“i2i”时，技能就会触发。

say.text: 把这张照片的背景换成沙滩。
say.note: Claude 会选择合适的模型并执行背景替换。

say.text: 批量把这组商品图的右下角水印去掉。
say.note: Claude 会使用批量编辑模型处理多张图片。

say.text: 把海报上的英文标题改成日文。
say.note: Claude 会调用支持多语言文字重写的模型。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude automatically selects the best image editing model based on your intent, enabling batch edits, text replacement, local modifications, or object removal, and invokes the RunComfy tool to complete the edits.
howto.when_en: The skill triggers when you explicitly ask to edit an image, such as saying "edit image", "swap background", "remove object", "rewrite headline", or mentioning "image-to-image" or "i2i".

say_en.text: Change the background of this photo to a beach.
say_en.note: Claude selects the right model and performs the background swap.

say_en.text: Batch remove the watermark from the bottom-right of these product images.
say_en.note: Claude uses the batch editing model to process multiple images.

say_en.text: Rewrite the English headline on the poster to Japanese.
say_en.note: Claude invokes the model that supports multilingual text rewriting.
